Free hosted audiovisual reviewer qualification candidate
=========================================================

This candidate provides a six-item blind audiovisual calibration panel, not a production-release publisher. It fetches three complete, immutable public pilot videos, creates three full-duration audio-defect controls while stream-copying the entire original video stream, then submits every whole MP4 through the Gemini Files API and Gemini 3.8 Flash GenerateContent. The request supplies audio and video together with the documented default 1 fps video frame sampling. The provider receives full timeline, picture, motion, captions and sound. Six randomized IDs withhold control labels. There is one GenerateContent call per item and at most six; quota refusal or any transport/provider failure is terminal. There is no retry, fallback, model rotation, Vertex or paid route. Files API status polling is bounded and only checks upload readiness.

No Mac programme media, Google API request or Actions run was used to build or test this candidate. Root owns integrating, reviewing and dispatching it. Sam confirmed the existing secret belongs to billing-disabled Google project gen-lang-client-0105607923; the value was never accessed. Runtime requires that exact project ID, Free-tier and billing-disabled declarations, the named secret, hosted Linux and FLEET_FREE_ONLY. This is provenance evidence, not proof of reviewer capability. Quota is determined by the single bounded run; there is no separate human quota gate. Official docs checked 2026-10-05: [Gemini API pricing](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing), [video understanding](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/generate-content/video-understanding), [GenerateContent API reference](https://ai.google.dev/api/generate-content).

Source binding:
- P1: public library exact FINAL-web bytes, 38,040,764 bytes, SHA-256 0ed30928dcd77ba3fbc565e832a0e31064c11a2f308e3d0a863956cc07f3277e; BUILD-NOTES identifies final web master as approved r7.
- P2: corrected audio-v2 public bytes, 237,283,443 bytes, SHA-256 1d6ec1c4a20eb1a3b8f1c7e21d96712b823f1b8532b6750b5fd964af47d17226.
- P3: corrected audio-v2 public bytes, 48,825,636 bytes, SHA-256 ef449e83f2b8c6b7f75e836cd9bcc0e65a231efc8e7f264f58f602d660ab391b.
The immutable asset receipt and calibration files are bound by hash and line range in the candidate manifest. P2/P3 are post-correction mix2 published revisions with passing text-calibration rows, not the originals. Historical P1 r6, original P2/P3, F01 rainbed and P1 low-pass ambience are unavailable and are not claimed tested.

Each source URL has QA tracking and is checked against exact byte count and SHA-256 before ffprobe. Expected full durations are 58.9, 59.7 and 58.4 seconds; each master must contain exactly one audio and one video stream. Three clean stimuli are byte-identical full-video copies. Three controls derive from P1 and preserve its entire video stream: periodic 12% gain during the first second of each four-second cycle, pink noise at amplitude 0.5 mixed without normalization, and a one-second audio dropout every eight seconds. ffprobe checks each derived file still contains both streams and covers the complete source duration. This covers the complete published web masters, not unpublished mezzanines or missing historic mixes.

For each blind item the raw provider response is written and fsynced before a result row is persisted. Only a nonempty, unblocked response with finishReason STOP counts complete; truncation and safety blocks stop the panel. Earlier completed response files/results remain in the artifact if a later item fails. Labels are held separately and committed by hash before calls. Artifacts are text/provenance/labels only, never video or credentials.

This is a finite blind calibration, not general reviewer qualification or release approval. A pass requires detection of all three severe controls, no defects claimed for the clean P1 r7/P2 v2/P3 v2 assets, and accurate timestamped evidence. Prior source audit records model misses, so qualification is not presumed. Unit tests run without network, credentials, programme media or filesystem writes. After root installs this exact payload to main, dispatch with that installed main SHA. The workflow installs FFmpeg on Ubuntu before checking ffmpeg/ffprobe. It refuses any other ref, current-head mismatch, first-parent/tree mismatch, changed native create/update preimage, missing payload or altered runtime hash. It then tests the negative controls and supports one bounded hosted run.
